publication issues.summary: Early unsealed partial V4: 23 unresolved render differences including six wire glyph differences and two uncertainties. Printed RT5C1BT4 conflicts with retained starred origin RT501BT4; no source correction inferred. BD printed pin 2EC3 is illegible and physical identity unresolved. Native, routes, omissions, registration and external schema review remain unassessed; no electrical completeness established. Team5 reports the ST BUS 51 native drawing prints *RT501BT4 at left and RT5C1BT4 by the diamond; both printed forms remain distinct claims. A helper viewed all 20 native tiles and the parent viewed overview and tile 10. Tile 32 shows BD near the diamond as 2EC3 without establishing a physical pin. Targeted tile views did not establish exact column mapping for six wire glyph differences; dense diamonds and damaged print remain ambiguous. Ninety routes, 27 junctions and 113 crossings were inventoried but not individually assessed; all 23 raw differences remain unreconciled.
publication issues.qualification: Published for access with the recorded review limitations; no electrical correctness or user approval asserted.
